### CVE-2023-28656 — NGINX Management Suite vulnerability
- Assigner: f5 | Published: 2023-05-03 | Updated: 2025-02-13 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: CWE-639 CWE-639 Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

NGINX Management Suite may allow an authenticated attacker to gain access to configuration objects outside of their assigned environment.  

Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

Affected:
- F5 / NGINX Instance Manager: affected 2.0.0 <2.9.0 (semver)
- F5 / NGINX API Connectivity Manager: affected 1.0.0 <1.5.0 (semver)
- F5 / NGINX Security Monitoring: affected 1.0.0 <1.3.0 (semver)

Credits: F5

References:
- https://my.f5.com/manage/s/article/K000133417 [vendor-advisory]
- https://security.netapp.com/advisory/ntap-20230609-0006/

### CVE-2023-28724 — NGINX Management Suite vulnerability
- Assigner: f5 | Published: 2023-05-03 | Updated: 2025-02-13 | Max CVSS: 7.1
- CWE: CWE-276 CWE-276 Incorrect Default Permissions
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

NGINX Management Suite default file permissions are set such that an authenticated attacker may be able to modify sensitive files on NGINX Instance Manager and NGINX API Connectivity Manager.
